entities.name: Adult granulosa cell tumor
observations: Estrogen-secreting ovarian sex-cord stromal tumor can cause abnormal uterine bleeding and endometrial thickening.
Inhibin B is a characteristic circulating marker; estrogen is a common secreted hormone.

entities.name: Estrogenic ovarian mass presentation
observations: In a middle-aged woman, heavy irregular bleeding, breast tenderness/enlargement, thickened endometrium, and an ovarian mass favor an estrogen-secreting granulosa cell tumor.
